#Kelp on Grazer Assay Bars 
```{r}
#importing google sheets 
GA_kelp_weights = 
"https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1d1CjDTCh7g108fjLrHlKTLF5tQDqrwpcJNINKTru3uI/edit?gid=0#gid=0"

kelp_on_GA <- read_sheet(GA_kelp_weights, sheet = "Sheet1")
```
```{r}
#averaging mean weight 
build_1 <- kelp_on_GA %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%
  group_by(date, site, plot, id, arkev, drift, time) %>%
  summarise(mean_weight_g = mean(weight_g))

#adding in plots from post time that had no kelp 
# get the unique site/plot/id/arkev/drift combos surveyed in pre
pre_combos <- build_1 %>%
  filter(time == "Pre") %>%
  distinct(site, plot, id, arkev, drift)

# find which of those combos never show up in post
missing_post <- pre_combos %>%
  anti_join(build_1 %>% filter(time == "Post"), by = c("site", "plot", "id", "arkev"))

# build the zero-weight rows for those missing plots
zero_rows <- missing_post %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date("2026-07-14"), # post survey date
    time = "Post",
    mean_weight_g = 0)

# bind back into the main df
build_2 <- bind_rows(build_1, zero_rows) %>%
  arrange(plot, id, arkev, time)

build_3 <- build_2 %>%
  group_by(arkev, drift, time) %>%
  mutate(treatment = paste(arkev, drift, sep = "_")) %>%
  group_by(treatment, time) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_weight = mean(mean_weight_g),
    se_weight = sd(mean_weight_g) / sqrt(n()),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(time = factor(time, levels = c("Pre", "Post"))) # keep pre before post

#renaming treatments
label_lookup <- c(
  "ARKEV_drift"      = "ARKEV + Drift",
  "ARKEV_no_drift"   = "ARKEV + No Drift",
  "Control_drift"    = "Control + Drift",
  "Control_no_drift" = "Control + No Drift")

build_3 <- build_3 %>%
  mutate(treatment_label = recode(treatment, !!!label_lookup))

ggplot(build_3, aes(x = treatment_label, y = mean_weight, fill = time)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_weight - se_weight, ymax = mean_weight + se_weight),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Pre" = "gray80", "Post" = "gray30")) +
  labs(
    x = "Treatment",
    y = "Mean kelp weight (g)",
    fill = "Deployment Period"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_family = "serif") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0))

```
```{r}
build_4 <- build_2 %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-date)

build_5 <- build_4 %>%
  mutate(treatment = paste(arkev, drift, sep = "_")) %>%
  select(plot, id, treatment, time, mean_weight_g) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = time, values_from = mean_weight_g) %>%
  mutate(pct_change = ((Post - Pre) / Pre) * 100)

build_6 <- build_5 %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_pct_change = mean(pct_change),
    se_pct_change = sd(pct_change) / sqrt(n()),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(treatment_label = recode(treatment, !!!label_lookup))

build_7 <- build_6 %>%
   mutate(drift = ifelse(grepl("no_drift", treatment), "no_drift", "drift"))

ggplot(build_7, aes(x = treatment_label, y = mean_pct_change, fill = drift)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_pct_change - se_pct_change, ymax = mean_pct_change + se_pct_change),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("drift" = "#6E8B3D", "no_drift" = "grey")) +
  labs(
    title = "Effects of drift enhancement on kelp biomass of GA bars",
    subtitle = "% change in kelp weight (g) before and after drift deployment (24hrs)",
    x = "Treatment",
    y = "% change",
    fill = "Treatment Type" ) +
  theme_classic(base_family = "serif") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5))
```
#Drift Surveys 
```{r}
drift_surveys_2026 = 'https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1_6FfkRoLTwMq54qiL4-9V68ELknBnJmNWHLyfnVYfSI/edit?gid=0#gid=0'

br_drift_survey <- read_sheet(drift_surveys_2026, sheet = "drift_survey_data")

deployment_info <- read_sheet(drift_surveys_2026, sheet = "big_river_deployment_location_info")

#data QA/QC

#define expected design 

expected_date_time <- tribble(
  ~date,        ~time,
  "2026-07-13", "0_hrs",
  "2026-07-14", "24_hrs"
)
 
#expected quadrats: N/E/S/W at 1m and 3m, plus GA at 0m = 9 quadrats per unit
expected_quadrats <- bind_rows(
  expand.grid(quadrat_ID = c("N", "E", "S", "W"), quadrat_distance = c("1m", "3m"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
  data.frame(quadrat_ID = "GA", quadrat_distance = "0m", stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
 
expected_plots <- 1:10


#check 1: rows missing plot/arkev_unit/arkev_type assignment
check_1 <- br_drift_survey %>%
    filter(is.na(plot) | is.na(arkev_unit) | is.na(arkev_type))
#^all good


# check 2: each plot has exactly one arkev unit and one control unit,
# per date x time point
 
check_2 <- br_drift_survey %>%
  filter(!is.na(plot)) %>%
  distinct(date, time, plot, arkev_unit, arkev_type) %>%
  count(date, time, plot, name = "n_units")
#^all fixed

#check 3
check_3 <- expected_date_time %>%
  pmap(function(date, time) {
    present <- br_drift_survey %>%
      filter(date == !!date, time == !!time, !is.na(plot)) %>%
      distinct(plot) %>%
      pull(plot)
    missing <- setdiff(expected_plots, present)
    if (length(missing) > 0) data.frame(date = date, time = time, missing_plot = missing) else NULL
  }) %>%
  bind_rows()
 
#check 4: missing quadrats
plot_units <- br_drift_survey %>%
  filter(!is.na(plot)) %>%
  distinct(plot, arkev_unit, arkev_type)
 
expected_skeleton <- expected_date_time %>%
  pmap(function(date, time) {
    plot_units %>%
      crossing(expected_quadrats) %>%
      mutate(date = date, time = time)
  }) %>%
  bind_rows()
 
check_4 <- expected_skeleton %>%
mutate(date = ymd(date)) %>%
  anti_join(br_drift_survey, by = c("date", "time", "plot", "arkev_unit", "arkev_type", "quadrat_ID", "quadrat_distance"))
#all fixed


#check 5: duplicate quadrats - same combo surveyed more than once
check_5 <- br_drift_survey %>%
  filter(!is.na(plot)) %>%
  count(date, time, plot, arkev_unit, arkev_type, quadrat_ID, quadrat_distance, name = "n_rows") %>%
  filter(n_rows > 1)


#check 6: drift_treatment should be constant within a plot/unit/type group
check_6 <- br_drift_survey %>%
  filter(!is.na(plot)) %>%
  group_by(date, time, plot, arkev_unit, arkev_type) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(drift_treatment) > 1) %>%
  distinct(date, time, plot, arkev_unit, arkev_type, drift_treatment) %>%
  ungroup()
```
#urchin figs

```{r}
urchin_cols <- c(
  "purple_urchins_<2cm",
  "purple_urchins_>2cm",
  "red_urchins_<8cm",
  "red_urchins_>8cm"
)


# convert the urchin list-columns to numeric
  # values such as "n/a", "NA", and blank cells become NA
  # actual zeros remain zero

urchin_clean <- br_drift_survey %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(urchin_cols), ~ map_dbl(.x, function(value) {
    if (length(value) == 0 || all(is.na(value))) {return(NA_real_)} # empty list element or missing value
        value <- as.character(value[[1]]) # extract the value from the list element
        value <- trimws(tolower(value)) # remove extra spaces and standardize capitalization
        if (value %in% c("", "na", "n/a", "nan", "none")) {return(NA_real_)} # convert text representing missing data to NA
        parse_number(value)}))) # convert valid values to numeric




# create a safe mean function
  #this calculates the mean using surveyed quadrats only.
  #if every value in a group is NA, it returns NA instead of NaN.

safe_mean <- function(x) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) {NA_real_} else {mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)}}


# assign the GA quadrat to 0 m and average densities
  # N, E, S, and W are averaged at 1 m
  # N, E, S, and W are averaged at 3 m
  # GA is retained as the single observation at 0 m

urchin_avg <- urchin_clean %>%
  mutate(quadrat_distance = case_when(quadrat_ID == "GA" ~ "0m",TRUE ~ quadrat_distance)) %>%
  group_by(site, date, plot, arkev_unit, arkev_type, drift_treatment, quadrat_distance) %>%
  summarise(purple_small = safe_mean(`purple_urchins_<2cm`),
            purple_large = safe_mean(`purple_urchins_>2cm`),
            red_small    = safe_mean(`red_urchins_<8cm`),
            red_large    = safe_mean(`red_urchins_>8cm`),
            n_expected = n(), # number of quadrat rows in each group
            n_surveyed = sum(!is.na(`purple_urchins_<2cm`) | # number of quadrats that were actually surveyed
                               !is.na(`purple_urchins_>2cm`) |
                               !is.na(`red_urchins_<8cm`) |
                               !is.na(`red_urchins_>8cm`)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(quadrat_distance = factor(quadrat_distance, levels = c("0m", "1m", "3m")))



# check groups with missing surveys
urchin_avg %>%
  filter(n_surveyed < n_expected)

urchin_long <- urchin_avg %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(
      purple_small,
      purple_large,
      red_small,
      red_large),
    names_to = "urchin_group",
    values_to = "mean_density") %>%
  mutate(urchin_group = factor(urchin_group,levels = c(
        "purple_small",
        "purple_large",
        "red_small",
        "red_large"),
      labels = c(
        "Purple urchins <2 cm",
        "Purple urchins >2 cm",
        "Red urchins <8 cm",
        "Red urchins >8 cm")))

# convert sampling dates to experimental time
urchin_plot_data <- urchin_avg %>%
  mutate(time = case_when(
      date == as.Date("2026-07-13") ~ "hr_0",
      date == as.Date("2026-07-14") ~ "hr_24",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
time = factor(time, levels = c("hr_0", "hr_24")),
quadrat_distance = factor(
      quadrat_distance,
      levels = c("0m", "1m", "3m"),
      labels = c("0 m", "1 m", "3 m")),
drift_treatment = factor(
      drift_treatment,
      levels = c("no_drift", "drift"),
      labels = c("No drift", "Drift"))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(time))
```

#figs
```{r}
#Total density of all purples and reds, averaged across quads by distance, from day 1 to day 2 
urchin_total <- urchin_plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    purple_total = purple_small + purple_large,
    red_total = red_small + red_large) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(purple_total, red_total),
    names_to = "species",
    values_to = "density") %>%
  mutate(
    species = factor(
      species,
      levels = c("purple_total", "red_total"),
      labels = c("Purple urchins", "Red urchins")))

ggplot(
  urchin_total,
  aes(
    x = quadrat_distance,
    y = density,
    fill = drift_treatment
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    position = position_dodge(0.8),
    width = 0.65,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = drift_treatment),
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = 0.15,
      dodge.width = 0.8
    ),
    alpha = 0.6,
    size = 2
  ) +
  facet_grid(
  species ~ time,
  scales = "free_y"
) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "No drift" = "honeydew1",
    "Drift" = "palegreen3"
  )) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "No drift" = "honeydew1",
    "Drift" = "palegreen3"
  )) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    x = "Distance",
    y = expression("Density (ind. "*m^{-2}*")"),
    fill = "",
    color = ""
  )
```

```{r}
distance_0_summary <- distance_0 %>%
  group_by(species, drift_treatment, time) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_density = mean(density, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(density, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(density, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop")

ggplot(
  distance_0_summary,
  aes(
    x = time,
    y = mean_density,
    color = drift_treatment,
    group = drift_treatment
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_density - sd,
      ymax = mean_density + sd
    ),
    width = 0.1
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    species ~ drift_treatment,
    scales = "free_y",
    labeller = label_value
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "No drift" = "firebrick",
      "Drift" = "darkgreen"
    )
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Change in total urchin density by species over 24 hour time period",
    subtitle = "at 0m from GA Bar",
    x = "Time",
    y = expression("Density (ind. " * m^{-2} * ") ± SD")
  )

purp_distance_1 <- purple_long %>%
  filter(quadrat_distance == "1 m")


purp_distance_1_summary <- purp_distance_1 %>%
  group_by(size, drift_treatment, time) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_density = mean(density, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(density, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(density, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop")

ggplot(
  purp_distance_1_summary,
  aes(
    x = time,
    y = mean_density,
    color = drift_treatment,
    group = drift_treatment
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_density - sd,
      ymax = mean_density + sd
    ),
    width = 0.1
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    size ~ drift_treatment,
    scales = "free_y",
    labeller = label_value
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "No drift" = "firebrick",
      "Drift" = "darkgreen"
    )
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Change in purple urchin density by size over 24 hour time period",
    subtitle = "at 1m from GA Bar",
    x = "Time",
    y = expression("Density (ind. " * m^{-2} * ") ± SD")
  )
```

```{r}
red_long <- urchin_plot_data %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(red_small, red_large),
    names_to = "size",
    values_to = "density"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    size = factor(
      size,
      levels = c("red_small","red_large"),
      labels = c("Sub-Legal (<8 cm)","Legal (>8 cm)")
    )
  )

ggplot(
  red_long,
  aes(
    quadrat_distance,
    density,
    fill = drift_treatment
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    position = position_dodge(0.8),
    width = .65,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = drift_treatment),
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = .15,
      dodge.width = .8
    ),
    alpha = .6,
    size = 2
  ) +
  facet_grid(size ~ time, scales = "free_y"
)  +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("No drift"="brown1","Drift"="firebrick")) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("No drift"="brown1","Drift"="firebrick")) +
  theme_classic(base_size=14)
```
